description: Edge detector, comparator and trigger-to-gate utility

params.text: The voltage the input must cross upwards to put the module in its high state, -10V to +10V
The voltage the input must fall below for the module to leave its high state, -10V to +10V
The least time the module stays in its high state, 0 to 1 second; it keeps fast inputs from jittering the outputs

inputs.text: The signal the two thresholds are compared against; the channels patched here set the polyphony

outputs.text: 5V for as long as the module is in its high state
A 1ms pulse at 5V each time the module enters its high state
A 1ms pulse at 5V each time the module leaves its high state
